name: Don't Breathe
detailed_description:
Don't Breathe is a horror abstraction game. You will be in the first person with different phenomena, various monsters, to start an immersive crack answer to complete the escape.

Product Features

-First perspective with camera mode, immersive experience - Be there and experience the real scene, let you try more.

-Multi organs, support achievement system, support digging and multiple experiences. More diversified.

-Multiple gameplay, discover the subsequent clearance clues from the scene interaction, come and play your fastest clearance record.

-Day and night system, different painting style.

-Difficult operation, 100% impossible to pass!

-A total of 3 levels, each level is different.

How to play

With up to 5 players online at the same time, you'll need to dodge monsters to get information, then find the orb and push it towards the hut to escape this strange place.

About me

I'm "Polygon Studio", a college student who makes games and plays them.
